observations: body L6, L7: «do-mns» is printed with an n (a turned u) for «domus»; transcribed as printed.
body L11: the Hebrew word «יָתֵד» has the qamats under the yod and the tsere under the tav; the full point stands at its right.

body L12, L13, L29: «εὐθεία» (L13) is printed with an acute on the iota (for εὐθεῖα; compare the acute of «ὑποτείνειν», L12, and the circumflex of «ἰδιοπροσωπεῖ», L29); transcribed as printed. «τῷ» and «κύκλῳ» have the iota subscript.
body L13, L15, L16: «تَامّ» has only the fatḥa on the tāʾ and the shadda on the mīm; «جَيْب» (L15, L16) has the fatḥa on the jīm and the sukun on the yāʾ, without a case ending.
body L17: the three points after the quotation stand at the left of «يُبْسَط», at the end of the Arabic run.

body L18, L21, L24, L34, L35: the 3s of «٣٧» (L18), «٣٣» and «٣٤» (L21), «٣٥» and «١٣٤» (L24), «٣٥» (L34) and «٣٦» (L35) have two crests and are 4.4-4.8 points wide; the 2s of the page measure 2.9-3.1 points.
body L19, L31: «310–312» (L19) and «Bouché–Leclercq» (L31) are printed with an en dash (5.5 and 5.6 points); «242-43» (L31) with a hyphen.
body L15, L26: the second line number after «٤٥» is a 5 with a damaged top (compare the 5 of «٦٨», L26).
body L22: the dash at the end of the line is 8.4 points long (the other em dashes of the page measure 9.3-10.6 points).
body L25, L27: «ζωδίων» is printed without the iota subscript.
body L24, L27: «الجِهَة» has the kasra and the fatḥa in L24, only the kasra in L27 («الجِهة»).
body L35: «المري» is printed with an elongated join (kashīda) after the mīm, not transcribed.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
